summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing for LabStock inventory management system. All 38 tests passed with 100% success rate. Critical FEFO (First-Expiry-First-Out) consumption logic verified and working correctly.
passed_tests: Auth: Admin/Tech login with correct credentials returns JWT token
Auth: Wrong password/PIN returns 401
Auth: GET /auth/me with/without token works correctly
Resolve: Unknown barcode returns found=false
Resolve: LOC: prefix returns type=location
Stock-in: Auto-registers unknown barcode and logs 'register' + 'in' actions
FEFO: Correctly consumes earliest expiry first (2026-01-01), then next (2026-06-01), leaves blank expiry untouched
FEFO: Reports shortfall when insufficient stock, no negative quantities
Stocktake: Sets counted qty and logs 'adjust' with difference
Move: Updates location and supports LOC: prefix
Item-update: Updates name/min_stock/location/storage/cost/unit
Dashboard: Returns KPIs (total_value, low_stock_count, expiring_count, expiring_buckets d30/d60/d90)
Dashboard: Returns reorder list (items below min_stock) and expiring list
History: Returns append-only log entries with item_name enrichment
History: Filter by action and technician works
CSV Import: Imports rows, auto-registers items, reports imported count and errors
Export: items.csv and history.csv return CSV with query token auth
Backup: Returns JSON snapshot with items/lots/log
User Management: Admin can list/create users, tech gets 403 on /api/users
Technicians/Locations: Return distinct lists
